FinancialInstitution.name: Financial Institution
FinancialInstitution.definition: Financial institution-related data required by business and/or regulation (for example, money or funds transfer).

Designation.name: Designation
Designation.definition: Identifies the specific payer when multiple payers are associated with the same account.

EntityType.name: Entity Type
EntityType.definition: Entity type of the payer, such as business, or individul.

AccountIdentifierType.name: Account Identifier Type
AccountIdentifierType.definition: Type of the payer's account identifier.

AccountIdentifier.name: Account Identifier
AccountIdentifier.definition: Value of the payer's account identifier.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of the cardholder, which is usually the full name.

MiddleName.name: Middle Name
MiddleName.definition: Middle name or initials present in the name of a person.

Contact.name: Contact
Contact.definition: Detail contact information of the payer.

Nationality.name: Nationality
Nationality.definition: Nationality information (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3) of the payer

CountryOfBirth.name: Country Of Birth
CountryOfBirth.definition: Country of Birth information (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3) of the payer

DateOfBirth.name: Date Of Birth
DateOfBirth.definition: Date of birth of the payer.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.

LocalData.name: Local Data
LocalData.definition: Contains text fields in the local language.
